title: Pixel Art Palette Generator
description: Build retro pixel art palettes with classic 8-bit/16-bit presets. Pick colors, reorder swatches, and export as PNG, HEX, or CSS variables.
howToUse: Pick a color and click Add, or load a preset (NES / Game Boy / Pico-8). Click a swatch to select it, then move it up/down or delete it. Export your palette as PNG, HEX text, or CSS variables, or copy all color values at once.
